wordGame.helpIntro: Find the exact Vietnamese spelling using the configured number of accepted guesses.
wordGame.helpAccents: E, Ê and Ế are different, as are D and Đ. “tiếng Việt” fills nine cells; spaces are ignored.
wordGame.helpRepeated: ✓ marks the right letter in the right place. ↔ marks a remaining occurrence elsewhere. × marks an absent or excess occurrence. Exact matches are counted first.
wordGame.helpRepeatedExample: Example with illustrative letter sequences (not necessarily dictionary words): answer AABBC, guess BABAA. Results in cell order: B ↔, A ✓, B ✓, A ↔, A ×. First reserve A in cell 2 and B in cell 3 as exact matches. Then, from left to right, B in cell 1 uses the remaining B and A in cell 4 uses the remaining A; A in cell 5 is excess. Accented letters are distinct: A does not match Á.
wordGame.helpInput: Use your installed Vietnamese keyboard, paste, or the ordinary virtual keys. Backspace deletes the last letter. A truly absent exact letter cannot be entered again; its accented variants remain distinct. A, E, I, O, U, Y and D have a separate arrow button for letter variants. Choose a letter to append it; Escape or an outside click cancels and returns focus to the opener.
wordGame.helpDictionary: Only published dictionary guesses use an attempt. Invalid guesses keep your input and reveal no feedback. Rounds are saved on this device for refresh recovery, including offline. New rounds need an online connection.
wordGame.confirmDescription: The current round will be replaced only after a new round loads successfully. Cancel to keep playing.
